about: Interface name to PortPosition { slot, subslot, index }, per paste platform, read by client/src/document/portTies.ts to suggest port ties. A rule suggests only when source names a vendor page with the date it was read (ADR-0034's rule). A rule with source null never suggests; its wanted line is the page the owner is asked for. Numbers are capture groups of pattern. No fuzzy matching and no first-free-port: a name no cited rule reads stays untied.

source.cite: Juniper Networks, "Understanding Interface Naming Conventions on EX Series Switches" (Junos 13.2): type-fpc/pic/port, FPC 0 on a standalone switch, PIC 0 for built-in ports, top row even and bottom row odd. Accepted by the owner on the sign-off page, round 27.

Juniper Networks, "SRX300, Configuring Junos OS": "The ge-0/0/0 and ge-0/0/7 interfaces (ports 0/0 and 0/7)", ports 0/1 to 0/6 are ge-0/0/1 to ge-0/0/6; the SRX340 page maps ports 0/0 to 0/15 the same way (its MGMT port is fxp0, which this pattern does not read). Plug-in Mini-PIM slots: the SRX300/SRX550M interface-modules page, slot/pim/port with pim 0. Owner accepted on the sign-off page, round 27.

Ubiquiti quick start guides, read 2026-10-16: ER-8 "RJ45 (eth0 - eth7 Ports)", "the port labeled eth0"; ER-X, ER-X-SFP (SFP is eth5), ER-4 (SFP is eth3), ERLite-3 and ERPoe-5 label ports eth0 upward the same way. ER-12 labels ports by number only ("RJ45 (Ports 0 - 9)") and its guide calls port 0 eth0. ER-6P's guide could not be opened. Owner accepted for every EdgeRouter, round 27.
